options.text: Can you tell me why you're here?

steps.player: Can you tell me why you're here?

steps.npc: Of course. I plan to assist the forces of Saradomin who will come to our aid, and fight against the legions of vampyres that infest this foul place. These brave mercenaries shall need a guide.
When a guide arrives, I will aid the mercenary by holding their wealth for their eventual return. The mercenary will repay the guide by giving [him/her/them] a token for items which I am holding.
I shall give such items to the guide as payment for their services once I'm handed the token.
Oh, the range of items is very varied. Mercenaries tend to hold raw materials in high esteem and so will deposit those with me. They also seem to be good bartering items.
Generally, things like uncooked lobsters, coal, silver bars, bow strings. Things which are useful! Plus the odd tome of experience, which are considered incredibly useful.

standard-dialogue-after-darkness-of-hall.npc: Hello friend. What can I do for you?

options.text: Could you exchange my tokens for me?
options.condition: If the player has a reward token (Burgh de Rott Ramble) in their inventory

steps.player: Could you exchange my tokens for me?

steps.npc: No need, friend. You can do that yourself.

options.text: Do you know what these nail beast nails are used for?
options.condition: If the player has nail beast nails in their inventory

steps.player: Do you know what these nail beast nails are used for?

steps.npc: Hmmm, not really sure. They do look disgusting though..oh, actually, I remember some other adventurers taking some of these to Sanfew now...something about being able to make a potion with them.

steps.player: Ok, so perhaps Sanfew knows then?

steps.npc: Maybe. It's worth a try. Next time you're in Taverley, pop in and ask him. I think I remember some adventurers saying something about a serum though, some sort of potion that can be made with them.

I hold some items for these good hearted souls so that the guide can be recompensed when the job is done.
